newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's February inflation 3.47 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's February inflation 3.47 pct - official.

text.p: Ecuador's Consumer Price Index rose by 3.47 percent in February, up from the 2.55 percent growth registered in the same month last year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Monday.
Cumulative inflation for the past 12 months was 31.7 percent, while cumulative inflation for the first two months of 1997 was 10.1 percent.
In the first two months of 1996 prices rose 5.0 percent.
Inflation in 1996 was 25.5 percent, up from 22.8 percent in 1995.
In January, consumer prices rose 6.4 percent.
The Central Bank manager said earlier Monday that the government expects to close 1997 with an inflation rate of around 30 percent.
